title: Gravity, Proprioception, Memory in Light of Piezo2 and Its Acquired Channelopathy as Neurodegenerative Diseases Show
content: The current perspective manuscript meant to introduce two distinctive proprioceptive pathway generation of one is gravity-dependent, while the other one is gravity-independent. The gravity-independent proprioceptive pathway also uses contributions from peripheral sensory receptors, but superpositioned by memory. The cerebellum is where this gravity-dependency diverge between proprioceptive pathways. The cerebellar dentate nucleus and its Piezo2 content may play an essentialrole to initiate this ultrafast memory superposition in synchrony with the hippocampus. Acquired irreversible Piezo2 channelopathy at certain loci along these pathways may initiate neurodegenerative diseases downstream.
